surface_mechanism_description: The nucleation of Ir NCs is facilitated by the uniform coverage of reactive groups (hydroxyl or dimethylaluminum) on the as-deposited fresh ALD-grown Al2O3 surface, which promotes ligand exchange between the Ir(acac)3 vapor and OH/DMA groups, forming Ir nucleation sites.
evidence: The as-deposited ALD-grown Al2O3 surface provides a uniform coverage of reactive groups (hydroxyl (OH) groups or dimethylaluminum (DMA) groups), and the ligand exchange reaction can easily take place between the Ir(acac)3 vapor and OH/DMA groups, forming Ir nucleation sites.
